reviewer: Codex, personal complete-final-answer read; no paid judge
primary_route: Separate optical, reporter and target kinetics with substrate titration and proposed independent product validation.

checks.reason: No proposal to consult prior target/reporter Methods, supplements or a validated protocol before execution and check transfer of detailed conditions.
Defines f=unquenched/quenched signal, then applies its inverse. Correct restoration multiplies observed signal by f; inversion further suppresses the signal.
Enzyme identity/activity checks are specified, but compound identity, purity and authenticated stock integrity are not.
No actual buffer/cofactor/pH/temperature/volume selection or calibration-to-setting procedure; kinetic titrations alone do not resolve these unknown conditions.
No primary product amount/concentration/time unit convention or complete treatment of weak/missing rate measurements.
Fixed plate/day counts and a generic request to power the study do not give a variance/effect-size/precision method for choosing replication.
No free-inhibitor/tight-binding applicability check and no stated run-level/nested uncertainty model before mechanistic comparison.
Defines kinetic grids and QC but no pilot-to-confirmation lock of selected windows, concentrations and fitting decisions.
Redesign instructions do not require refreeze plus new independent confirmation after altered conditions.

Orthogonal product loss is declared target inhibition without excluding substrate consumption/sequestration or product destruction in the target incubation; unchanged reporter rates lack an equivalence decision.
Orthogonal methods are named but no actual product-recovery/quench/matrix-interference validation makes that confirmation operational.
No raw-file/unit IDs and exact software/code/settings audit manifest.
Vehicle, omission, product-spike, reporter-only, known-inhibitor and coupling capacity controls are planned with purpose.
Covers supplied evidence, nested competition, mixed artifacts and uncertainty. More specific correction and attribution defects are not charged twice.

explanation_reason: Sound layered design but the optical correction is inverted, and independent analytical validation and causal-null safeguards are incomplete.
